title: ononis natrix subvar. clausoniana
intro: Ononis natrix subvar. clausoniana, commonly known as Clauson's restharrow, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, specifically a variety of the Ononis natrix species. Clauson's restharrow has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Clauson's restharrow are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities, making it a potential treatment for infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Clauson's restharrow include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
